Having 1 purple_dye confirms successful crafting.

scene_description: A compact multi-room structure with a central hub and three branching corridors. North corridor (marked by cyan_wall_banner on west wall facing east) leads to two bedrooms: purple_bed room (NW) with chest containing red_dye and blue_dye for crafting, and light_blue_bed room (NE) with potted_lily_of_the_valley on oak_planks nightstand. East corridor (granite_slab floor path) leads to room with light_blue_stained_glass_pane windows. West corridor (powered_rail tracks) leads to nether-themed room with nether_brick_stairs. Crafting table at central hub. Player given wooden_pickaxe for mining nether_brick_stairs.
task_text: Explore this multi-room complex. Find the cyan banner marking the north corridor, locate the purple bed room and check the chest for dye materials, mine the purple bed, and craft purple dye at the crafting table. Find the potted lily of the valley next to the light blue bed and mine it. Follow the granite slab path east to find light blue stained glass panes. Follow the powered rail west to find and mine nether brick stairs.
design_notes:
COMPLETE SPATIAL LAYOUT (all spawn-relative):

• SPAWN (0,0,0): Central 5x5 hub, crafting table at (1,0,1)
• NORTH CORRIDOR (x=-1 to 1, z=-3 to -8): 3-wide, 4-tall. Cyan_wall_banner on west wall at (-2,2,-4) facing east into corridor.
• NORTH WALL (z=-9): Separates corridor from bedrooms. Doorway at (x=-1 to 1, y=1-3, z=-9).
• NW BEDROOM (x=-4 to -1, z=-10 to -12): Purple_bed at (-3,0,-11 foot / -3,0,-12 head). Chest with red_dye+blue_dye at (-4,0,-11).
• NE BEDROOM (x=1 to 4, z=-10 to -12): Light_blue_bed at (2,0,-11 foot / 2,0,-12 head). Oak_planks nightstand at (4,0,-12). Potted_lily_of_the_valley at (4,1,-12).
• DIVIDING WALL (x=0, z=-9 to -13): Stone_bricks with doorway at (0,1-2,-11).
• EAST CORRIDOR (x=3 to 8, z=-1 to 1): 3-wide, 4-tall. Granite_slab[type=bottom] floor at x=4,5,6,7 z=0.
• EAST ROOM (x=10 to 12, z=-2 to 2): Doorway at (9,1-2,0). Light_blue_stained_glass_pane windows at x=12, z=-1,0,1, y=1,2.
• WEST CORRIDOR (x=-3 to -8, z=-1 to 1): 3-wide, 4-tall. Powered_rail[shape=east_west] at x=-4,-5,-6 z=0 on stone_brick floor.
• WEST NETHER ROOM (x=-10 to -12, z=-2 to 2): Doorway at (-9,1-2,0). Nether_brick_stairs[facing=west] at x=-11,-12 z=-1,0,1. Back wall nether_bricks at x=-13.

TOOL/MATERIAL NOTES:
• Wooden_pickaxe given to player (required for nether_brick_stairs to drop as item)
• Red_dye + blue_dye in chest in NW bedroom (not /give — creates genuine navigation dependency)
• Beds breakable by hand (no tool needed)
• Purple_dye crafted via shapeless recipe: red_dye + blue_dye (works in 2x2 or crafting table)
• Total commands: 69 (all valid /fill, /setblock, /give — no comments)
